title: IT Act ss. 15–17 — Salaries & Perquisites (IT Act ss. 15-17)

content.overview: Salary is charged under section 15 when it is due, paid or allowed, whether or not it is actually drawn in advance or in arrears. Section 17 defines salary to include wages, annuity, pension, gratuity, fees, commission, perquisites and profits in lieu of salary. A perquisite is a benefit in the employment relation. An allowance is taxable unless an exemption applies. The charge follows the employment relation and the due or payment event. A gift outside employment is not salary.

cases.name: Union of India v. Mohit Minerals Pvt. Ltd.
cases.facts: The case concerned GST levy and the legal effect of a Council recommendation.
cases.issue: What is the constitutional and statutory force of GST Council recommendations?
cases.ratioDecidendi: GST Council recommendations have persuasive value within the constitutional design but are not automatically binding as primary legislation without statutory implementation.
cases.holding: The Court interpreted the federal GST framework accordingly.
cases.relevance: Use for GST levy, delegated action and constitutional federalism.

Section 17 defines salary to include wages, annuity, pension, gratuity, fees, commission, perquisites and profits in lieu of salary. A perquisite is a benefit in the employment relation. enhancement.legalPrinciple: The charge follows the employment relation and the due or payment event. A gift outside employment is not salary.
enhancement.detailedExplanation: Section 15 prevents escape by timing: due, advance, and arrears are covered. Section 17(2) lists perquisites, including the value of rent-free accommodation and benefits the rules value. Profits in lieu of salary include compensation on termination as enacted. Standard deduction and exemptions for specified allowances are computation and exemption rules, not part of the charge.
examples: A rent-free house from the employer is tested as a perquisite.
A post-employment compensation is tested under profits in lieu of salary.
